questions.text: CSS 2022 · Pair: Annalist / Analyst — Which meaning fits “Annalist”?

options.C: A person who writes annals, i.e. year-by-year historical records
options.D: A person who examines data in detail

questions.explanation:
Annalist: A person who writes annals, i.e. year-by-year historical records. Sentence: "The court annalist recorded every major event of the emperor's reign, year by year."
Analyst: A person who examines data or situations in detail to explain them. Sentence: "The financial analyst studied the company's accounts before advising investors."
Source: CSS 2022 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2022 · Pair: Gest / Jest — Which meaning fits “Gest”?

options.A: A story or deed of adventure, especially a heroic exploit (also 'geste')
options.C: To restrain or keep something under control; a restraint
options.D: To disturb or unsettle someone's composure

questions.explanation:
Gest: A story or deed of adventure, especially a heroic exploit (also 'geste'). Sentence: "The medieval poem is a gest celebrating the brave deeds of a wandering knight."
Jest: A joke or playful remark; to speak in fun. Sentence: "He said it only in jest, but his friend took the remark seriously."
Source: CSS 2022 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2022 · Pair: Sleigh / Slay — Which meaning fits “Sleigh”?

options.A: A sledge drawn by horses or reindeer, used for travel on snow
options.D: A harsh, high-pitched sound, e.g. from an old door or floor

questions.explanation:
Sleigh: A sledge drawn by horses or reindeer, used for travel on snow. Sentence: "The family rode across the snowy fields in a horse-drawn sleigh."
Slay: To kill violently (literary); (informal) to impress greatly. Sentence: "In the legend, the prince set out to slay the dragon that terrorised the village."
Source: CSS 2022 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2022 · Pair: Shoot / Chute — Which meaning fits “Shoot”?

options.A: To fire a weapon; a new growth from a plant
options.C: Dry and withered (of plants or land)
options.D: A sloping channel for sliding things down

questions.explanation:
Shoot: To fire a weapon; a new growth from a plant. Sentence: "After the rain, green shoots appeared on the bare branches; the soldier was trained to shoot accurately."
Chute: A sloping channel or slide for conveying things or people to a lower level. Sentence: "The workers sent the rubbish down a chute from the tenth floor to the skip below."
Source: CSS 2022 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2022 · Pair: Coign / Coin — Which meaning fits “Coign”?

options.A: A projecting corner of a wall; 'coign of vantage' = a good viewpoint
options.B: A flat metal piece used as money
options.C: Having a single origin; (biology) produced asexually from one parent
options.D: To cry or shout loudly and noisily

questions.explanation:
Coign: A projecting corner of a wall; 'coign of vantage' = a good viewpoint. Sentence: "From his coign of vantage on the tower's corner, the guard could watch the whole valley."
Coin: A flat piece of metal used as money; to invent a new word or phrase. Sentence: "He dropped a ten-rupee coin into the box; Shakespeare coined many words still used today."
Source: CSS 2022 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2022 · Pair: Key / Quay — Which meaning fits “Key”?

options.A: Excessively fond of or submissive to one's wife
options.B: A current of cool air in a room; (British) a drink or a game piece
options.C: A platform where ships load and unload
options.D: An instrument for opening a lock; something crucial

questions.explanation:
Key: An instrument for opening a lock; something crucial. Sentence: "Hard work is the key to success; she lost the key to her front door."
Quay: A stone or concrete platform along water where ships are loaded and unloaded. Sentence: "The cargo ship tied up at the quay, and workers began unloading the containers."

questions.text: CSS 2022 · Pair: Wile / While — Which meaning fits “Wile”?

options.B: Everyone or everything in one group or at the same time
options.C: A projecting corner of a wall; 'coign of vantage' = a good viewpoint
options.D: A clever trick or stratagem meant to deceive (usually plural: wiles)

questions.explanation:
Wile: A clever trick or stratagem meant to deceive (usually plural: wiles). Sentence: "The fox used all its wiles to steal the chickens without being caught."
While: A period of time; during the time that. Sentence: "Please wait a while; I will finish the letter while you drink your tea."
Source: CSS 2022 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2022 · Pair: Leek / Leak — Which meaning fits “Leek”?

options.B: Escape of liquid or gas through a hole
options.C: A baby's cot with barred sides; (informal) to copy dishonestly
options.D: A vegetable related to the onion, with a long white stem

questions.explanation:
Leek: A vegetable related to the onion, with a long white stem. Sentence: "She chopped a leek and added it to the soup for a mild onion flavour."
Leak: An accidental escape of liquid or gas through a hole; to let out secret information. Sentence: "A gas leak in the kitchen was found just before anyone lit the stove."
Source: CSS 2022 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).
